name: CLM
aliases: Smart Caching Policy for Gaussian States
definition: A method that removes the GPU memory barrier by moving Gaussian states between CPU and GPU memory during optimization, using a smart caching policy to keep the most frequently updated Gaussians on the GPU.
summary: CLM optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by dynamically migrating Gaussian states between CPU and GPU memory based on temporal locality, eliminating performance bottlenecks caused by memory barriers.
